title: Malaysia eyes Davao coconut shells for energy use

blocks.text: DAVAO CITY — The Department of Agriculture (DA)–Davao Region has begun discussions with a Malaysian company about potential market opportunities for coconut shells as an alternative energy resource. Through its Agribusiness and Marketing Assistance Division (AMAD), DA-Davao Region officials recently met with Borneo New Energy representatives to assess the availability and volume of coconut shells. The foreign business group also wanted to explore potential collaboration on the coconut’s sustainable use. The company expressed interest in purchasing coconut shells for energy production, with an initial plan for about 100 metric tons, pending further assessment of supply capacity.
